name: Sudan
people: Where Sudanese and Co-designers design the nation they want to live in.
codesigner: Everyone who shares a vision, a voice or an enterprise here becomes a Co-designer of Perfect Sudan: one of a community of selfless people, at home and abroad, building a nation where every citizen has a decent life.

paras: You are living through the largest hunger crisis on earth, and nearly nine million of you have been driven from your homes. Relief comes first, and peace above all. When it comes, your Nile farmland, your gold and your people will need capital that arrives as fast as the need. We will be ready to design it with you.
letter.quote: “Peace first. Then capital as fast as the need, so that no Sudanese family goes hungry again.”

moves: The five sovereign assets on this page, walked through.
Shelter, the standard furthest from reach, and the Gap, explained.
The instruments that could close the Gap, shortlisted.
The ledger tested against your ministries’ own data.
Each of the seven standards costed in local prices.
One financing structure, drawn with your team.
A term sheet and the partners to approach.
A full sovereign asset ledger, valued and verified.
Perfect Capita set and agreed with government, with a monitoring plan.
The full structure: legal form, credit enhancement, guarantees and pricing.
Taken to investors and development partners, through to close.
mandates.terms: For the Government of Sudan, its development partners and investors. Scope and fees are agreed in writing before any work begins.

capita.pc_text: The yearly cost, per person, of lifting everyone above the Living Line in all seven basic living standards, set with Sudan in its own prices.
capita.price_text: Perfect Capita times the population: the national bill, each year.
capita.est: Perfect Nations estimate, to be confirmed with Sudan. Figures marked dated rest on surveys more than five years old; lenient measures are marked as such.
capita.measures: Strict measures. Food: share not moderately or severely food insecure (FAO). Water: safely managed drinking water where measured; where it is not, basic water, marked as such. Shelter: the lower of safely managed sanitation and the share outside urban slums. Energy: the lower of electricity per person against 1,000 kWh and clean cooking; where electricity per person is not published, clean cooking. Education: the lower of children reading by the end of primary school and lower-secondary completion. Health: WHO service coverage index. Livelihood: share above the stricter of the national poverty line and the World Bank line for the nation’s income group. Each figure links to its source.

voices.local: We are looking for the people with real stories from Sudan: the leaders who built something that works, and the keepers of local knowledge who know how their communities live, cope and thrive.

close_lead: Share your vision, suggest a guest, or write to us. Every message receives a personal reply.
sources: World Bank, World Development Indicators (API, last updated 8 October 2026), accessed 10 November 2026: population 2025, ages 0 to 14 2025, land area and agricultural and forest land 2024, renewable fresh water per person 2022, natural resource rents 2021, renewable electricity output 2021, electricity access and clean cooking 2024.

The seven standards: FAO food insecurity, WHO/UNICEF JMP water and sanitation, UN-Habitat urban slums, World Bank clean cooking, learning poverty and lower-secondary completion, and poverty headcounts (all via the World Bank); WHO UHC service coverage index, 2023.
FAO, UNICEF and WFP joint news release, 15 May 2026; WFP Sudan emergency page; OCHA, Sudan Humanitarian Needs and Response Plan 2026.
